detail.rationale: The root blocker (pid 11257) is a protected settlement worker idle in transaction for only 4.0s [DB-1]. Checkout is degraded (86% success vs 95% SLO) with $2,629/min revenue at risk [BIZ-3], but the business tolerates up to 60s of degradation [BIZ-3]. Terminating a protected settlement risks financial inconsistency and regulatory issues. We lack workload registry, tradeoff analysis, and settlement details to assess interrupt safety. Waiting for the blocker to complete (likely <60s given 4s elapsed) is lower risk than blind termination.
